snippet.title: Crazy Frog Racer (PC) - Gameplay | No Commentary
snippet.description:
Take Crazy Frog, known from the ring tone, and a bunch of his friends and enemies in crazy kart-style races around 12 tracks in 4 cups (baby, funny, crazy and special), and collect the crazy power-ups. Hopefully you like his trademark sounds because you'll hear them quite often.

▌PC Gameplays Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXEHhSievieFw3PRaPmrVQ4mTjr4BMRE0

💰 Here you can buy games at good prices: https://www.g2a.com/n/ncgyt
